compiled_state.title: ci-llm-review: DSO-Story-Merge trailers on empty recovery commits -> full diff reviewed
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

The provenance pipeline sees all implementation commits as unprovenanced. DSO-Story-Merge: trailers are on empty recovery commits with no file diffs. Implementation commits carry DSO-Story: (task attribution), not DSO-Story-Merge: (story merge). Integration review reviews the full diff instead of the cross-branch subset.

**Impact**: Full diff reviews lead to more findings, higher token usage, and more frequent blocking.
**Related**: bug e349 (known gap in ci-pr trailer injection)

comments.body: Classification: behavioral, Score: 5 (INTERMEDIATE). Severity=2(high), Complexity=2(complex), Environment=1(CI), Intermittent=0(deterministic). User-provided root cause analysis included.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: Investigation complete (INTERMEDIATE). Root cause confirmed: CI integration-scope falls through to full-diff when INTEGRATION_SCOPE empty because DSO-Story-Merge trailers on empty recovery commits yield 0 files, and pipeline doesn't distinguish 'all provenanced, no cross-branch' from 'no trailers found'. Fix: condition full-diff fallback on provenance-complete.marker + empty unprovenanced-shas.txt in ci.yml Union step.
comments.author: Test
